gist: Leon Smith is stepping down as Great Britain Davis Cup captain after seventeen years.
He guided the team to a historic title victory in 2015.
His final tournament in charge will be the upcoming Finals in Bologna.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Great Britain Davis Cup captain Leon Smith announced he is leaving his post after nearly seventeen years. He will step down following the upcoming Finals in Bologna. The Lawn Tennis Association has spoken to potential candidates but has not yet named a successor.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Smith took charge in 2010 when the team faced relegation. He successfully revived the squad and led them to their first title since 1936 in the year 2015, supported by player Andy Murray.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Smith hopes to achieve another successful run at the Bologna Finals. Afterwards, he will remain in his position as the head of British men's tennis while the LTA searches for his replacement.

Formula 1.title: F1 to introduce full-time race stewards from 2027
Formula 1.standfirst: Formula 1's governing body the FIA is to introduce permanent race stewards from the 2027 season.

articles.title: F1 to introduce full-time race stewards from 2027
articles.standfirst: Formula 1's governing body the FIA is to introduce permanent race stewards from the 2027 season.

gist: Formula 1 will introduce permanent race stewards from the 2027 season.
The change addresses driver criticisms regarding inconsistent penalty decisions for on-track incidents.
Driver stewards and existing FIA stewards will continue to play a vital role.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The FIA announced it will introduce permanent race stewards starting in 2027 following consistent calls from grand prix drivers. A small number of full-time stewards will be recruited during 2027, with the group expanding from 2028.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Drivers have frequently complained that penalty rulings were applied inconsistently. The FIA stated that dedicated full-time stewards will provide continuity, expertise, and greater consistency in decision-making.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The FIA will begin recruiting permanent stewards for a phased introduction during the 2027 season, while continuing to use driver stewards and existing personnel on a mixed roster.

fivew: To provide continuity and expertise and improve consistency in decision-making.

quotes.text: F1 and the FIA all agree that permanent stewards should be the way forward
This latest major investment in FIA officiating reflects our dedication to delivering the highest standards of decision-making, fairness and integrity in motorsport.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Andriy Shevchenko stated that Mykhailo Mudryk's representatives repeatedly asked for a football federation employee to falsely take the blame for Mudryk's positive test for meldonium. Mudryk, suspended from November 2024 to July 2026, blamed the Ukrainian Association of Football for the failed test, claiming it happened on international duty and criticizing a lack of support.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Shevchenko called the claims baseless slander and defended the professionalism of association staff, while Mudryk argued the handling of the matter delayed his return to football.
